args.title: Tamarack Newsletter Summary – Freight Pricing This Quarter
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Freight pricing this quarter" from Tamarack Components highlights that spot rates have fallen 9% while contract rates held steady, with fuel surcharges now tracking weekly diesel prices.
- Linked article: Expands on the same freight pricing trends—spot rate softening vs. stable contract pricing, and the shift to weekly (rather than monthly/quarterly) diesel-indexed fuel surcharges.
- Companion piece (subscriber-only): Finds that shippers who split their freight volume across three carriers paid the lowest overall rates this quarter.
